title: RimPLC rung (frozen v1)
description: One rung of the ladder: when (an AND of conditions) -> then (ordered advice steps). Same meaning as a gate in docs/playbook.gates.json read by .local/autopilot/gates.py. Lower priority is scanned first. A missing key fails its condition (unmeasured is not false). An unresolved bound fails and is reported in unresolved_conditions.

id.description: Unique. Rungs added through the AI API are prefixed unity-, rungs made in the in-game editor player-. A unity-/player- rung with the id of a book rung replaces it.

priority.description: Lower runs first. Rungs from GRACE_FROM_PRIORITY up to 99 (except id always) wait until day > START_GRACE_DAYS.

then.description: Advice steps, shown to the player and handed to the AI as the live rung. Rungs added through the API are capped at 8 lines of 300 characters.

check.description: The question this rung answers (chain rungs).

notice.description: One line for a human. RimPLC posts it as a game message on the rung's rising edge (book and player rungs only).

latch.description: Done-latch: mark_<id>_done false is added to when and 'ladder_set mark <id>_done true' to then.

disabled.description: Present = the rung never fires. The value is the reason.

mode.description: advise never runs coils; auto runs coils on the rising edge; off equals disabled. Rungs added through the AI API are forced to advise.

requires.description: A rung whose requirement is not active is shown as not applicable and never scanned.

when.description: AND of conditions. Key = a sensor, mark_<name>, alert_<x>, a tag name, or letter_matches.

letter_matches.description: Case-insensitive substring of any letter label in the stack.

condition.description: bool: truthiness equals. number: numeric equality (a bool value never equals a number). A string starting with < > != <= >=: comparison against a number, a {TAG}, or another measured key or tag name. Any other string: exact text equality.

coil.description: Executable output. P1 runs message, set_mark and set_tag only (no game state changes), and only on auto rungs. The rest are reserved for P3.
